//: ops-pipeline#25. Before this file existed there was NO tsconfig here, so
`npx tsc --noEmit` in this directory silently printed usage text and exited 0
against ZERO inputs — a check that had never checked anything (Rule #382).
A typecheck job without this file would be theater (Rule #376).
NodeNext is load-bearing, not stylistic: package.json sets "type": "module"
and every internal import carries an explicit .js extension (e.g.
./lib/automerge-classify.js). Any other moduleResolution reports those as
unresolved and the typecheck goes uniformly red for the wrong reason.
